fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2026-09-13, the complainant paid Rs. 12,00,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed. The time of the incident was given as 12:30 on 2026-09-12. The complainant, Sanjay Raj, provided the contact number 9000000083. The account reference SYN-ACC-100062 linked to the complainant was mentioned in relation to the transactions. The complainant alleged that Karthik Shankar may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000306. Potentially relevant material referenced includes transaction records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, bank account, residential colony, suspect, mobile number, transaction record, afternoon
